title: Recover Lost or Discarded Commit via Reflog
code:
git reflog | grep -E "commit|checkout" -m 5
git checkout -b recovery-branch <commit-hash>
explanation: Git keeps a chronological ledger (reflog) of every HEAD update, even for deleted branches or commits dropped by git reset --hard. Locating the hash allows instant recovery into a branch.
caveat: Reflog entries expire after 90 days for reachable commits and 30 days for unreachable commits by default, or after git gc runs.
